description: This Dart source file defines the application's routing logic using the go_router package for a Flutter healthcare app. It configures public and protected routes, a shell route with a bottom navigation bar, and an authentication guard that redirects based on secure storage token presence. It also includes placeholder screen classes for different app sections.

classes.name: AppRouter
classes.description: A singleton class that configures and manages app routing using go_router with route definitions, a navigation guard, and navigation methods.
